title: im_hobo

creators.name: Kennedy, Adam
creators.affiliation: H.J. Andrews Experimental Forest LTER, Oregon State University

description:
im_hobo performs QA/QC on CSV files exported from Onset HOBO data loggers (via HOBOware), producing timezone-corrected, unit-converted, timestep-synchronized output files (CSV, TOA5, and Parquet) with automated file management, ready for import into analysis workflows such as the GCE Data Toolbox.

This material is based upon work supported by the H.J. Andrews Experimental Forest and Long Term Ecological Research (LTER) program under the NSF grant LTER8 DEB-2025755.
